About Us

Abacus Insights is transforming how data and AI work for health plans. Our mission is simple: make healthcare data usable, so the people responsible for care and cost decisions can act faster, with confidence.

As the AI and Data Platform for Payer Intelligence, we help health plans break down data silos to create a single, trusted data foundation. That foundation powers better decisions—so plans can improve outcomes, reduce waste, and deliver better experiences for members and providers alike. Backed by $100M from top investors, we're tackling big challenges in an industry that's ready for change. Our platform enables GenAI use cases by delivering clean, connected, and reliable healthcare data to support automation, prioritization, and decision workflows—and it's why we are leading the way.

Our innovation begins with people. We are bold, curious, and collaborative—because the best ideas come from working together. We embrace the thoughtful use of AI and automation to drive innovation and efficiency, and we look for individuals who are curious and adaptable—those excited to leverage emerging technologies to enhance how we work—while keeping human insight, connection, and our clients at the center of every decision.

The Alarm.com Software Rotation Program is a structured, cohort-based experience designed for exceptional early-career engineers who want to build deep technical expertise across Alarm.com's most strategic product areas. jobs.description_text:

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Backend (Observability)
jobs.description_text:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

The Observability team builds the platform every Affirm engineer relies on to understand the behavior and performance of our systems. Our platform ingests 200+ TB/day of metrics, logs, and traces from hundreds of services across 80+ Kubernetes clusters, and when a user's checkout fails, our data is how engineers find out why. Over the next year, we’re moving to wide events, with one context-rich event per request, improving the signal-to-noise ratio to make debugging faster. We’re also introducing log sampling and building observability best practices into agentic development and code review, so that AI-assisted code is well instrumented by default.

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to be the technical lead for Observability. You’ll spend most of your time hands-on while defining the roadmap, driving cross-functional projects, mentoring a team of six engineers, and partnering closely with infrastructure and product teams.


What You'll Do

· You will own the architecture of Affirm’s telemetry pipeline, balancing reliability, query performance, and cost at 200+ TB/day.
· You will design log sampling strategies that significantly reduce volume and cost without losing the signal engineers

jobs.description_text:
About the Team

Our team is at the core of Avride's self-driving stack. We build the base infrastructure layer that powers all autopilot code. It includes a C++ framework for implementing autonomy components, execution graph building and optimization systems, as well as runtimes that execute those graphs, both onboard and in simulation.

The vast part of the execution graph is implemented as a chain of neural network operations. The onboard mode relies on stable latencies of the inference of those networks, while in simulation we also optimize throughput at scale.

About the role

We’re looking for a software engineer with a leadership mindset and deep ML infrastructure experience. You will decide and influence the ML infrastructure layer across the company. The biggest challenge we’re facing at the moment is the effectiveness of GPU inference - both for onboard applications with near real-time guarantees and for offboard cases that target high throughput and deterministic execution. It is the first priority within this role.

What you'll do

  • At first, you will take on the GPU inference framework, focusing on performance
  • Later, the role assumes responsibility and ownership for broader ML infrastructure scattered across ML pipelines
  • Close collaboration with the applied ML team responsible for defining the neural model's architecture

jobs.title: HFT Production Engineer
jobs.description_text:
关于我们

AXQ 安贤投资 是一家全球量化投资机构。我们立足不同地域、资产类别和交易周期，持续构建多元化的投资优势。我们的策略植根于严谨的量化研究与深入的市场理解，并通过对数据、技术和人工智能的长期投入不断强化。我们汇聚来自全球顶尖高校及领先量化机构的优秀人才，倡导以好奇心、严谨精神和主人翁意识为基础的合作文化。在这里，最好的想法能够脱颖而出，每个人也能与公司共同成长。

 

岗位职责

作为高频交易生产工程师（HFT Production Engineer），您将与开发、研究及交易团队紧密合作，保障全球交易系统的稳定运行，负责高频交易策略及相关系统的生产部署、运行保障与持续优化，重点关注行情与交易链路、低延迟运行及生产稳定性。您的主要职责包括：

  • 实盘运营与监控：负责盘前检查、盘中运行保障及盘后核查，关注策略运行、持仓、交易限额及行情与交易链路状态。
  • 事故响应与问题排查：处理生产异常，重点排查交易链路延迟异常，协调内部团队及经纪商、交易所等外部合作方，开展根因分析与事后复盘，持续完善系统可靠性及运行手册（runbook）。
  • 策略部署与变更管理：支持策略及系统上线，完成版本与参数校验、部署验证及回滚，并按预案及授权执行生产应急操作。
  • 监控自动化建设：开发和维护监控、告警及运维工具，跟踪交易链路延迟和关键运行指标，提升系统可观测性与运维效率。
  • 高频交易系统支持：参与行情与交易接口的联调及故障排查，协同开发团队解决网络、性能及系统运行问题。

 

岗位要求

  • 具备两年及以上高频交易实盘生产运维（HFT ProdOps）经验，独立承担过策略部署、生产支持及故障处置，并具有交易链路延迟异常的排查经验。

关于我们

AXQ 安贤投资 是一家全球量化投资机构。我们立足不同地域、资产类别和交易周期，持续构建多元化的投资优势。我们的策略植根于严谨的量化研究与深入的市场理解，并通过对数据、技术和人工智能的长期投入不断强化。我们汇聚来自全球顶尖高校及领先量化机构的优秀人才，倡导以好奇心、严谨精神和主人翁意识为基础的合作文化。在这里，最好的想法能够脱颖而出，每个人也能与公司共同成长。

 

岗位使命

作为机器学习基础设施工程师（Machine Learning Infrastructure Engineer）你将参与建设 AXQ 面向量化研究与机器学习的计算和平台基础设施，与 Infrastructure 团队及研究、工程团队紧密合作，提升特征计算、模型训练、实验迭代与推理任务的效率和可靠性。

我们面向 PB 级数据处理与大规模机器学习训练场景，持续优化 GPU/CPU 计算资源、分布式计算、存储与数据访问、机器学习平台及开发者工具。

你将参与相关基础设施系统与平台工具的设计、开发与交付，帮助研究人员更高效地使用计算资源，让研究工作流具备可扩展、可复现、易使用和成本高效的特性。

 

主要职责

  1. 计算集群与任务调度：建设和优化 GPU/CPU 资源管理与任务调度系统，提高计算资源利用率和任务运行效率。
  2. 分布式训练与计算：支持多 GPU、多节点计算任务，优化数据加载、任务并行、节点通信与故障恢复。

  4. 机器学习平台与研究工具：开发任务提交、实验管理、开发环境及依赖管理工具，提升研究效率与可复现性。

jobs.description_text:
About Clockwork Systems

Clockwork.io – Software Driven Fabrics to increase GPU cluster utilization

Clockwork Systems was founded by Stanford researchers and veteran systems engineers who share a vision for redefining the foundations of distributed computing. As AI workloads grow increasingly complex, traditional infrastructure struggles to meet the demands of performance, reliability, and precise coordination. Clockwork is pioneering a software-driven approach to AI fabrics by delivering cross-stack observability to catch and quickly resolve problems, workload fault tolerance to keep jobs running through failures, and performance acceleration that dynamically routes and paces traffic to avoid congestion.

To learn more, visit www.clockwork.io.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to contribute to the architecture, development, and scaling of a high-performance network monitoring and observability platform. This role will focus on building systems that provide deep visibility into RDMA, RoCE, InfiniBand, and TCP/IP networks. The ideal candidate has strong experience in distributed systems, Linux networking, and modern observability stacks (e.g., Grafana/Prometheus).

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description_text:
Opportunity Overview:

As DevOps and Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), you’ll be part of the action - working closely with application teams to automate / optimize infrastructure, and solve issues in an exciting, fast-paced environment. You’ll play a vital role in ensuring that our systems are reliable, scalable, and high-performing.

You would design, implement, and manage robust observability solutions across our cloud infrastructure and applications. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Prometheus, Grafana, AWS Cloud Monitoring, Datadog. You should be comfortable working with metrics, logs, and traces, and be able to correlate telemetry data to proactively detect, diagnose, and resolve issues.

What You’ll Do

  • Automate deployments and Implement release governance. 
  • Site Reliability Engineering: Maintain SLAs, SLIs/SLOs. 
  • Implement observability dashboards & metrics. 
  • Monitor production systems. 
  • Enforce security best practices- support audit and compliance activities. 
  • Implement and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform. Develop automation scripts and self-healing mechanisms to reduce manual intervention.
  • Required Skills: AWS, Lambda ECS, CloudWatch, API Gateway, Okta, Terraform, GitHub Actions, CI/CD Jenkins.
  • SRE Observability Monitoring, Alerting, Incident Management. Manage incident

Recruitment Fraud Alert

We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.  

What to know:

  • Commvault does not conduct interviews by email or text.
  • We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.
  • Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.

If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com
